treasury_interest_placement.rate_formula: 4% annualized base + 0.5 percentage points for each 100 currency of qualifying treasury growth, capped at 12%; internal transfers do not count as treasury growth.
treasury_interest_placement.settlement: completed after the three-month observation period

previous_action: Gaius Maximus Valerius organizes his funds as efficiently as possible before the final inspection of the three-month treasury placement, protects operating reserves, and continues recruiting men on demonstrated merit by offering shelter, food and personal responsibility in return for defined service.

continuity.campaign_development: During October, Valerius completed the three-month treasury inspection, realized fifteen currency of interest at a six percent annualized rate, reorganized liquid reserves, and admitted seventy-five men through merit-based recruitment under defined shelter-and-service terms.
